_comment: Starting categories offered during setup, by profession. Compiled into the app (src-tauri/src/presets.rs checks it in tests). Hints are shown to the AI to help it file screenshots, so keep them concrete. Names: at most 40 characters; hints: at most 160. Miscellaneous is always added by the app; don't list it here.
